renderProfile.backgroundPolicy: film_transparent=True, PNG RGBA, no text, no wordmark, no black studio backdrop.

controlledGaps.impact: The ball rotation is real for nodeIndex 23, but the current GLB does not expose an independent 阀杆 node; do not claim stem-driven coupling.

axisInference.pipeAxisSource: dominant center separation between the two 阀座 node groups
